description:
JOIN CONTORO ROBOTICS – REVOLUTIONIZING WAREHOUSE AUTOMATION WITH CUTTING-EDGE ROBOTICS

At Contoro Robotics, we're on a mission to solve labor challenges through advanced robotic solutions. Headquartered in Austin, TX, our fast-growing startup is transforming the supply chain industry with our flagship warehouse automation technology. Our team is made up of top-tier experts in robotics, AI, and logistics, working together to push the boundaries of automation.

We’re looking for talented and ambitious individuals to join us on this journey—helping shape the future of robotics while growing alongside a world-class team. If you're passionate about innovation, problem-solving, and making a real-world impact, we want to hear from you!


ROLE AT A GLANCE

The Test & Validation team verifies and validates Contoro’s robotic systems before they reach customer sites, ensuring every robot performs reliably in demanding environments. We’re looking for a Test & Validation Engineer to own how our robot’s hardware is tested and qualified, produce results the team can trust, and grow into owning hardware reliability across the fleet.

The immediate focus will be hands-on: building test fixtures, running functional, durability and environmental tests on end effectors, subsystems and full robots, and leading root cause analysis alongside our mechanical, electrical and manufacturing engineers. As you learn the system, your scope will expand to defining reliability test strategy, qualifying new hardware revisions and suppliers, and serving as the central point of contact for hardware release decisions.

We are looking for someone committed to understanding the problem in depth. You will build a thorough understanding of the conditions our robots operate in, including trailer environments, heat, dust, vibration, box weights and duty cycles, as well as how and why hardware wears and fails in the field. You will then use that understanding to design tests that reproduce real-world stress and find issues before they reach our customers.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Design test plans and procedures with clear objectives, sample sizes and pass/fail acceptance criteria, based on requirements, design specs and known field failure modes

 - Lead reliability & durability testing on end effectors, vacuum and pneumatic systems and other wear components resulting into recommendations that shape the next hardware revision

 - Build test benches, test articles, fixtures and instrumentation for endurance, accelerated life and environmental testing that replicate real-world duty cycles and operating conditions

 - Work side by side with mechanical, electrical and manufacturing engineers to trace hardware failures from testing and the field to their root cause through teardown and analysis

 - Partner with the deployment and field service teams to take every field failure from test, to fix, to verified hardware revision

 - Track key reliability metrics, failures, and corrective actions through closure (FRACAS), and verify fixes with follow-up testing

 - Run trade studies on components, materials, suppliers and design options, weighing performance, reliability and cost, and present recommendations to engineering

 - Write clear, structured and traceable test and failure analysis reports covering objectives, setup, hardware revisions and results against acceptance criteria


ABOUT YOU

Required Skills

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics or Robotics Engineering or a related field, or 5+ years of experience designing and testing hardware platforms

 - First-principles understanding of electromechanical systems, including mechanical design, motors and actuators, sensors, pneumatics and vacuum systems

 - 2+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and executing test procedures for complex electromechanical systems in a lab or startup environment

 - Familiarity with core hardware test methodologies: verification and validation (V&V), functional, environmental, durability and accelerated life testing

 - Ability to analyze test and field data with statistical and reliability methods (hypothesis testing, design of experiments, Weibull analysis) and explain what the results show

 - Hands-on experience building test fixtures, setting up devices under test, sensors and data acquisition equipment: mounting, wiring, calibrating and verifying the setup before running tests

 - Ability to understand engineering drawings, electrical schematics and test procedures, and resolve missing information with the appropriate responsible engineer

 - Excellent written and verbal communication

 - Willingness to travel to customer sites (up to 10%)

Preferred Skills

 - Structured root cause methods (5 Whys, fishbone, FMEA) and failure tracking (FRACAS)

 - Experience testing vacuum grippers, pneumatics or end effectors

 - Familiarity with engineering change processes, including engineering change orders (ECOs) and change control boards (CCBs)

 - Experience with industrial robot arms (KUKA) or warehouse automation

 - Familiarity with finite element analysis (FEA) simulations

 - CAD (SolidWorks or Onshape) for fixture design

 - Basic Python or scripting for test data collection and analysis

 - Tracking work in Jira, Confluence or similar tools
